title: Design System: Firmo Barbearia (Capa synth)

scope.statement: This file governs landings-motion/firmo.html only. PRODUCT.md requires every business page to have its own bespoke visual world, with no shared look across the ten landings. Nothing here (palette, type, chamfers, grid, motion) is a project-wide default; other business pages must not inherit it. A new business page starts its own world.

line.note: Cyan at 28%; hairlines and inset frames at rest. CSS var --line.

line-strong.note: Cyan at 60%; hover and lit frames. CSS var --line-strong.

display.purpose: FIRMO logotype only; skewX(-9deg), violet 10-step 1px depth ramp under a pink-magenta-violet gradient face.

score.purpose: The 4,9 high score; yellow with an 11-step ramp to violet, skewX(-7deg), tabular.

headline.purpose: Uppercase section titles, skewX(-6deg), 6-step violet ramp, one word in magenta.

hook.purpose: Hero hook line, one phrase in yellow; 22ch phones, 30ch from 900px.

title.purpose: Slot names, perks, FAQ questions; uppercase Tektur 800 at width 88-92%.

body.purpose: Paragraphs in soft, quotes in ink; intros max 58ch.

label.purpose: Legends, captions, readout heading; cyan by default, yellow in the readout.

shapes.name: chamfer
shapes.purpose: Button bottom-right cut (CSS var --chamfer); 10px on small buttons.

shapes.name: chamfer-slot
shapes.purpose: Service slot top-right cut, diagonal drawn as a gradient line.

shapes.name: chamfer-frame
shapes.purpose: Photo screen bezel outer/inner two-corner cut; facade bottom-right cut.

shapes.name: diamond
shapes.purpose: Map pins and legend numbers.

shapes.name: sun-mask
shapes.value: 7 horizontal bands thinning toward the horizon
shapes.purpose: Banded half-disc sun, the only curved form.

shadows.name: cta-glow
shadows.purpose: Wrapper of every primary button outside the HUD.

shadows.name: extrude-logotype
shadows.purpose: Depth layer of the FIRMO logotype.

textures.name: crt-scanlines
textures.purpose: Over the waiting-room photo; the facade uses .18 lines with a violet-to-void wash.

textures.name: sky-title
textures.value: linear-gradient(180deg,#05050c 0%,#0b0f2b calc(var(--hz)*.34),#2a0f4f calc(var(--hz)*.69),#8e1f73 calc(var(--hz)*.91),#ff2d95 var(--hz),#05050c calc(var(--hz) + .2%))
textures.purpose: Title screen sky keyed to the horizon value.

textures.name: css-grid-floor
textures.value: two 1.5px cyan linear-gradients, 56px (divider) or 64px (CONTINUE) cells, perspective(260px|320px) rotateX(62deg|64deg), masked to fade
textures.purpose: Horizon dividers and the CONTINUE floor.

textures.name: canvas-grid
textures.value: 16 rows on z^2.2, alpha .12+.75z, width .6+1.4z; vanishing lines max(18, W/46); fill #1a0636 to #05050c; magenta horizon glow over top 22%

motion.name: ease-out
motion.value: cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)
motion.purpose: Default ease for entrances, nav underline, dock, FAQ icon (CSS var --ease-out).

motion.name: ease-sweep
motion.value: cubic-bezier(.7,0,.2,1)
motion.purpose: Clip-path sweeps: CRT boot, section title type-in, score rows printing.

motion.name: spring-entrance
motion.value: type: spring; bounce .22-.5; visualDuration .4-.6
motion.purpose: Logotype letters (bounce .38, stagger .07), pins (.5), select slots (.22, alternating ±70px), score scale (.45), CONTINUE? title (.4).

motion.name: spring-press
motion.value: press scale .95 (bounce 0, .12s) then release to 1 (bounce .6, .35s)

motion.name: scroll-sunset
motion.value: sun translateY 0% to 85% over the title's scroll; title copy lifts -90px, scales .9, fades to .15; bottom copy drops 60px and fades by 60%
motion.purpose: Signature: the sun sets as the page scrolls.

motion.name: grid-velocity
motion.value: offset += dt*(0.55 + boost); boost += |lenis velocity|*0.02 (cap 5); boost *= 0.92 per frame
motion.purpose: Signature: grid forward speed follows scroll velocity; runs only while the canvas is visible and the tab is shown.

motion.name: smooth-scroll
motion.value: Lenis 1.3.26, lerp .11, anchor offset -64px

motion.name: loops
motion.value: coin blink 1.1s steps(1); pin ring 2.4s; divider grid roll 1.6s; CONTINUE floor roll 1.4s
motion.purpose: Ambient arcade loops, gated by html.moving.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: html.calm set before paint from prefers-reduced-motion (or when Motion fails to load); all CSS animations/transitions off; no Lenis; canvas draws one still frame; reveal states are only applied by JS when moving, so content is visible by default

breakpoints.name: phone-max
breakpoints.purpose: Horizon to 50%, subtitle stacks, score table two columns.

breakpoints.name: table
breakpoints.purpose: High-score table gains the source column.

breakpoints.name: desktop
breakpoints.purpose: HUD nav on, dock off, multi-column sections, 4-up select, split console, sticky score.

narrative.overview:
Firmo is the title screen of a 1986 arcade cartridge. The page is night: an indigo-to-void sky, a neon magenta horizon, a banded yellow-to-magenta sun sitting on a cyan wireframe grid that runs toward the viewer, black mountain ridges with a magenta rim at the edges. Everything else is read as game UI on that night: booking is PRESS START, services are a player-select screen, reviews are the high-score table, the closing call is CONTINUE? with a countdown.

Density is low and theatrical. Each section is one game screen with one dominant object (the CRT photo, the select grid, the giant score, the facade), separated by horizon dividers that redraw the sun's horizon line over a short strip of rolling grid. Light comes from the neon itself: magenta glows, cyan lines, yellow signals. Surfaces are void or night; nothing is a pale card.

Motion is part of the world, not decoration on top of it. The grid's forward speed follows scroll velocity, the sun sets as the title scrolls away, and every section enters with its own game verb (CRT boot, pins dropping, players sliding in, scores counting up, rows printing). With reduced motion the page is complete and still. The world refuses the dark-leather-and-brass barbershop with a split hero and a row of service cards.
keyCharacteristics: Void and night surfaces lit only by magenta, cyan and yellow neon.
Extruded italic display caps: Tektur 900, skewed, with a continuous 1px stepped depth ramp.
Wide Saira body and tracked wide cyan caps for labels.
Corners are chamfered, never rounded; markers are diamonds.
The receding cyan grid recurs: canvas hero floor, horizon dividers, the CONTINUE floor.
Photos are always shown through a screen: chamfered gradient frame plus CRT scanlines.
Selection lights magenta; score, today and focus light yellow.

rules.name: The Neon On Void Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are void, night or a dark indigo gradient. Neon colors are light sources: lines, glows, text, small fills. The only large neon fields are the sky gradient and the sun.

rules.name: The Magenta Means Chosen Rule
rules.body: The active or selected element lights magenta along its full width (a slot's edge and gradient, a legend row's sweep, a pressed pin). Do not use magenta for passive decoration of controls.

rules.name: The Yellow Is Score Rule
rules.body: Yellow marks what the game wants you to notice: the score, today, the coin cue, keyboard focus, pins. Keep it off body copy and large surfaces other than the demo strip.

rules.name: The Extruded Title Rule
rules.body: Display, headline and score type gets depth from a continuous text-shadow ramp stepping 1px per layer, light to dark along one hue family, closed by one soft blurred drop. Never a single hard offset.

rules.name: The Skew Rule
rules.body: Only extruded display type is skewed, between -6deg and -9deg. Body, labels and buttons stay upright.

rules.name: The Wide Label Rule
rules.body: Labels are Saira at width 112% to 125%, tracked 0.14em to 0.42em, uppercase, cyan by default (yellow inside the readout).

rules.name: The Glow Not Lift Rule
rules.body: Boxes never get offset shadows. A lit object glows with a blurred drop-shadow in its own neon color; everything else is flat and framed.

rules.name: The Chamfer Rule
rules.body: Any frame or control that needs a corner gets a 45-degree cut sized 10px to 22px, never a radius.

dos: Do treat this file as the Firmo world only; start any other business page from its own world.
Do key the sky, sun, ridges and grid to one horizon value (64%, 50% under 600px).
Do build display depth as a 1px-per-step ramp in one hue family plus one blurred drop, as on the logotype, section titles, score and countdown.
Do cut corners with `clip-path` at 45 degrees (10px to 22px) on buttons, slots and photo frames.
Do show every photo through the bezel or chamfered frame with scanlines over it.
Do give each section its own entrance verb with springs or the `cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)` ease-out, and keep content visible with no JavaScript or reduced motion.
Do keep touch targets at 44px minimum and primary CTAs at 56px.
donts: Don't apply this palette, type pairing or grid motif to another business's landing page.

Don't give boxes, cards or buttons offset shadows; lit objects glow, everything else is framed.
Don't fill large areas with neon or put body copy in yellow or magenta.
Don't skew body text, labels or buttons.
Don't drift toward the dark-leather-and-brass barbershop: no brass, wood, leather textures or serif signage.

worldsRule: One world per business page. Worlds must not be mixed: no token, rule, texture, component or motion from one world applies to another page.

card.note: Page ground and the calendar's header card, with grain and a 6px dot screen. CSS var --card.

card-deep.note: Sticky paper bar, nail socket, sheet perforation holes, scrollbar track. CSS var --card-deep.

paper.note: Every sheet, the demo strip, the photo border, text on red. CSS var --paper.

paper-edge.note: Visible paper thickness (folha edge, pad underlay) and photo frame fill. CSS var --paper-edge.

green.note: Body text and day numerals on paper; ink button line and hover fill. CSS var --green.

green-ink.note: Folha headings, condensed labels, dashed and 2px rules; at 25-50% alpha every hairline. Same value as card. CSS var --green-ink.

red.note: Stamp button, Sundays, score, menu numbers, pen marks, grip cue, emphasis words, today's hours row, focus ring. CSS var --red.

red-deep.note: Link hover on paper. CSS var --red-deep.

soft.note: Secondary text on paper: ledes, descriptions, captions, citations, legends. A lighter impression of the green ink, not a third hue. CSS var --soft.

on-card.note: Heading and primary text on the green card and in the bar. CSS var --on-card.

on-card-soft.note: Secondary text and nav on the green card and in the bar. CSS var --on-card-soft.

day-numeral.purpose: Date on each tear-off sheet; dark green, red on Sundays; lining figures.

score.purpose: The 4,6 in red; the closing 'Tem.' uses the same voice at clamp(90px, 22vw, 180px).

display.purpose: Headline beside the calendar from 900px, paper on card, emphasis underlined 4px.

headline.purpose: Section headings in green-ink with one word in red.

name.purpose: 'Pizzaria Da Vinti' on the header card; bar wordmark at 24px; month caption in red.

condensed-title.purpose: Ways list headings; FAQ questions at width 80%, clamp(18px, 2.6vw, 22px).

weekday.purpose: Weekday under the day numeral; red on Sundays.

body.purpose: Paragraphs; ledes in soft at max 58ch.

button.purpose: Every button; 14px in the small bar stamp.

label.purpose: Month line, captions, 'Pensamento do dia', 'desde 2017'; grip cue and 'hoje' tag are 800-weight siblings.

shapes.name: card
shapes.purpose: Calendar header card.

shapes.purpose: Folhas and photo frames / tear-off sheets and notes.

shapes.purpose: Top edge of every folha.

shapes.name: perforation-sheet
shapes.purpose: Top edge of tear-off sheets.

shapes.purpose: Border strip of whole red/green triangle modules (28x14 SVG): card top at 12px, folha at 22px inside.

shapes.name: staple
shapes.purpose: Pins the pad at 22% from each side.

shapes.name: nail-and-string
shapes.value: SVG 120x46: strings #e9e3cf 1.6px from (60,6) to both corners; head #9aa39c r5.5 with #dfe5e0 highlight; socket 12px card-deep with inset 0 2px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.6)
shapes.purpose: Hangs the calendar; pivot 34px above the card.

shapes.name: torn-stub
shapes.value: Random jagged 9px SVG fringe, fill #ebe6d8; at most three kept
shapes.purpose: Left on the perforation after each tear.

shapes.name: pen-loops
shapes.purpose: Four authored loops in a 100x64 box, two passes each (main 2.3-3.4px, second 1-1.3px at .75-.8); chosen by day % 4; month-grid tilt (d*47 % 11) - 5 deg.

shapes.name: pen-strike
shapes.purpose: Closed: double strike, main pass heavier.

shapes.name: pen-underline
shapes.value: 2px red bar, 2px radius, 4px past each side, 5px below the figure
shapes.purpose: Saturday's later close.

shadows.name: pad-edges
shadows.purpose: Pad underlay depth (paper tones only, per The Paper Edge Rule).

textures.name: grain
textures.value: SVG feTurbulence fractalNoise baseFrequency .9, 2 octaves, warm brown at 50% alpha, 160px tile (CSS var --grain)
textures.purpose: Card stock and every paper surface.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.value: cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)
motion.purpose: Default ease: nav underline, dock, FAQ icon, ways and menu entrances (CSS var --ease-out).

motion.name: hang-swing
motion.value: rotate -5deg to 0; spring bounce .5, visualDuration 1; transform-origin 50% -34px
motion.purpose: Calendar swings onto its nail on load.

motion.name: riffle
motion.value: 4 past-day sheets; perspective(600px) translateY 0 to -20px, rotateX 0 to 75deg, opacity 1 to 0; .26s easeIn each, delay .55s + .15s steps; origin 50% 0
motion.purpose: Sheets flip off the pad until today shows.

motion.name: grip-nudge
motion.value: y 0, 4, 0; .9s easeInOut, delay 1.6s, repeat 2

motion.name: tear-drag
motion.value: translate(dx*.4, dy>0 ? dy*.6 : dy*.12) rotate(dx*.04deg); threshold dy>70 or |dx|>110; short release springs back bounce .45, visualDuration .4

motion.name: tear-fall
motion.value: y [0,-14,.9*innerHeight], rotate [0,-3d,26d], x [0,6d,120d], opacity [1,1,0]; 0.9s, ease [0.3,0,0.7,1], times [0,.15,1]; calendar kick rotate [0,-2d,1d,0] .9s easeOut
motion.purpose: Torn sheet falls with weight toward the drag side; stub added.

motion.name: restock
motion.value: y -24 to 0, opacity 0 to 1; spring bounce .3, visualDuration .5
motion.purpose: After the last sheet, today drops back onto the pad.

motion.name: scroll-sway
motion.value: kick = clamp(lenis velocity*.012, ±.6) while scrollY < 1.2 viewports; per frame v += -angle*.06; v *= .9; angle += v
motion.purpose: Calendar sways on its nail with scroll velocity.

motion.name: folha-entrance
motion.value: y 60 to 0, rotate ±1.2deg (alternating) to 0, opacity 0 to 1; spring bounce .25, visualDuration .7; inView amount .08
motion.purpose: Each section sheet is pinned on.

motion.name: pen-draw
motion.value: strokeDashoffset L to 0; month loops .35s easeOut, 35ms stagger from .15s, second pass to .75 opacity; today's sheet .6s at 1.35s; status .45s, .15s apart; 'hoje' tag scale 0 to 1 spring bounce .5

motion.name: section-verbs
motion.value: ways y 24 stagger .1; menu items x -24 stagger .12; photo taped rotate 6 to -1.5, scale .94 to 1 spring .35; notes dealt y -40, rotate ±8 spring .35, .14s apart; 'Tem.' stamped scale 1.8 to 1, rotate -8 to -3 spring .3; photo parallax 8%

motion.name: stamp-press
motion.value: press scale .96, rotate -.6deg (spring bounce 0, .12s); release to 1, 0 (bounce .55, .35s)

motion.name: smooth-scroll
motion.value: Lenis 1.3.26, lerp .11, anchors offset -64px, autoRaf

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: html.calm set before paint from prefers-reduced-motion, or when Motion fails to load; all CSS animations and transitions off; no Lenis, swing, riffle, sway or entrances; content visible by default; tear removes the sheet instantly

breakpoints.name: desktop
breakpoints.purpose: Bar nav on, dock off; hero 440px calendar + side copy; ways 3-up; house 1.15/.85; reviews .8/1.6 with two-column rotated notes; address 1fr/1fr.

narrative.overview:
Da Vinti is the tear-off calendar that hangs in every kitchen in Ana Jacinta. The page is the wall: green card stock in the pizza box's green, printed with a fine dot screen, carrying newsprint sheets. At the top the calendar hangs from a nail on a string: a green header card with the pizza photo set in a paper border, the name in a heavy didone, and under it a stapled pad of day sheets. Today's sheet shows the date, the weekday, today's hours and a review as the thought of the day. Every later section is another sheet (folha) pinned to the card stock, with a perforated top edge and a printed border strip.

Everything printed on paper uses two inks, green and red. Green carries text, rules and headings; red carries the big answer figures, Sundays, pen marks and the one stamped action. Open and closed are never a colour: a day is circled in red pen when open and struck through when closed, the way someone marks a real calendar. The month grid proves the habit with a pen circle around every night.

Motion is the calendar behaving like an object. It swings onto its nail on load, the past days' sheets riffle off the pad until today shows, the top sheet tears away under a drag or tap and falls with weight, the calendar sways on its nail with scroll velocity, and each folha is pinned on with a small spring. Pen strokes draw themselves. With reduced motion the calendar hangs still, the sheets are already on today, a tear swaps the sheet instantly, and every section is visible. The world refuses the rustic checkered-tablecloth pizzeria with a hero photo under a serif headline.
keyCharacteristics: Green card stock (with grain and a 6px dot screen) carrying newsprint paper sheets.
Two inks on paper: green and red, nothing else.
Abril Fatface didone for names, headings and giant numerals; Archivo for body; Archivo condensed caps (72% to 82% width) for labels and buttons.
A printed module border of red and green triangles, repeated in whole modules only.
Perforated top edges on every paper sheet; staples, nail and string, stacked pad edges, torn stubs.
Authored red pen marks: a loop for open, a strike for closed, an underline for Saturday's late close.
One red printed stamp for the menu action; secondary actions are ink outlines.

rules.name: The Two Inks Rule
rules.body: Anything printed on paper is green (`green`, `green-ink`, or its pale impression `soft`) or red (`red`, `red-deep`). No third hue, no tint of red, no gradient on paper. Paper tones and metal are material, not ink.

rules.name: The Red Stamp Rule
rules.body: A red-filled block at button size is the menu action only ("Cardápio", "Pedir pelo cardápio"). WhatsApp and Google Maps are ink outlines. The only other red fills are small: the "hoje" tag in the month grid and the `[confirmar ...]` markers.

rules.name: The Pen Not Colour Rule
rules.body: Open, closed and "every night" are said with red pen marks drawn from authored paths, never with a status colour, dot or badge: a loop circles an open day, a double strike crosses a closed one, a short underline marks Saturday's later close.

rules.name: The Didone Figure Rule
rules.body: Abril Fatface is for names, headings and figures only, never under 24px and never for body, labels or buttons. Big figures that answer a question (Sundays, the score, the menu numbers, "Tem.") print red; ordinary days print green.

rules.name: The Condensed Caps Rule
rules.body: Every label, weekday, button and small heading is Archivo uppercase at width 70% to 82%, weight 700 to 800, tracked 0.02em to 0.2em. Body text stays at normal width.

rules.name: The Paper Edge Rule
rules.body: A zero-blur offset is allowed only directly under paper, in paper-edge tones (`paper-edge` and the three pad steps), to show the thickness of a sheet or pad. Never in black, never on buttons or controls.

rules.name: The Whole Module Rule
rules.body: The border strip repeats in whole modules only (`background-repeat: round`); a cut triangle at either end is a defect.

rules.name: The Perforated Top Rule
rules.body: Every paper sheet (folha, tear-off sheet, note) carries perforation along its top edge, holes coloured by the surface behind it.

dos: Do treat this part as the Da Vinti world only; start any other business page from its own world.
Do print everything on paper in two inks: green (`green`, `green-ink`, `soft`) and red (`red`, `red-deep`).
Do reserve the red stamp fill for the menu action and use the ink outline for WhatsApp and Maps.
Do mark open, closed and every night with authored red pen paths drawn in two passes, never with a colour or badge.
Do set names, headings and numerals in Abril Fatface, labels and buttons in Archivo condensed caps (width 72% to 82%).
Do give every paper sheet a perforated top edge and repeat the module strip in whole modules (`background-repeat: round`).
Do show paper thickness with solid offsets in paper-edge tones only (folha edge, pad edges).
Do keep the calendar physical: swing, riffle, tear with weight, sway with scroll, and keep a working, instant tear under reduced motion.
donts: Don't mix this world with Firmo or any other page's world: no neon, no chamfers, no extruded type here, and no card stock, two inks or pen marks there.
Don't introduce a third ink, a tint of red, or a gradient on paper.
Don't give buttons a ledge or a hard offset shadow; the stamp sits on a soft blurred drop.
Don't set Abril Fatface under 24px or use it for body text.
Don't use green or red dots, pills or fills to say open or closed.
Don't drift toward the rustic checkered-tablecloth pizzeria with a hero photo under a serif headline.

motion.name: street-drive

narrative.overview:
Planet Patas is the shop's real sign turned into a van's livery, and the page is the táxi dog's round trip: casa, Planet Patas, casa, cheiroso. The sticky header is the sign itself, a royal blue board with the name in white rounded Nunito at its heaviest weight and "pet shop" in gold caps, with the orange-red band under it carrying "Rações · Medicamentos · Acessórios · Banho e Tosa" exactly as the facade does.

One asphalt road with white dashes runs the full length of the page down the left edge and never breaks or wraps. The hero ends in a horizontal street: a side-profile white "TÁXI DOG" van in the livery (orange stripe, blue lettering and paw, gold light, a dog at the window) drives from the "Sua casa" corner to under the facade photo. From that corner the vertical road takes over, and a small top-down van rides it as the chase light, always marking where the visitor is; the road behind it fills gold. Every section is a stop with a round blue plaque on the road, and each plaque turns gold once the van passes and stays lit. The trip ends at "Em casa" on a blue and white checker ground.

Blue and orange shout as a pair across full-colour fields; white and pale tint fields alternate with blue ones so the page reads as the sign, not as a white page with a blue accent. Real photos (the facade, the shampoo shelf, the toys, the pomeranian in front of the in-store checker backdrop) carry the proof. The world refuses the pastel paw-print-wallpaper pet template and the row of four service cards.
keyCharacteristics: The sign as livery: royal sign blue fields, white rounded Nunito 900 to 1000, an orange-red band.
One unbroken asphalt road with white dashes on the left edge, filled gold behind the van.
Two vans, one on screen at a time: the side-profile "TÁXI DOG" van on the hero street, the top-down chase van on the road.
Round blue stop plaques with a white ring that turn gold when reached and stay lit.
The in-store blue and white checker backdrop as the arrival material.
Pill buttons; orange for booking banho e tosa, blue for section actions.
Round, plaque-like forms everywhere; soft navy-tinted drops, no hard offsets.

rules.name: The Shout in Pairs Rule
rules.body: Blue and orange commit together at full strength: sections are whole fields (blue, white, tint, blue, white, blue on checker), the sign band and the booking buttons are orange. A viewport is never a neutral page with a blue accent.

rules.name: The Band Is Booking Rule
rules.body: An orange-filled pill at button size is the banho-e-tosa booking (header Agendar, hero, finale, the floating WhatsApp). Section-level actions on white (Pedir o táxi dog, Abrir no Google Maps) are blue pills; the hero's secondary is a white-line pill.

rules.name: The Gold Is Now Rule
rules.body: Gold marks progress and the present: the travelled road, reached stops, the van's lights, today's hours row, focus. It sits on blue or as a fill behind sign-ink text, never as text on white or tint.

rules.name: The One Rounded Voice Rule
rules.body: Nunito is the only face, at weight 500 or heavier: 900 to 1000 for names, headings, figures and buttons, 700 to 800 for emphasis and small sign text, 500 for body.

rules.name: The Sign Caps Rule
rules.body: Uppercase tracking (0.14em to 0.18em) belongs only to text the sign or the road carries: "pet shop" under the wordmark and the stop labels. Headings stay sentence case.

rules.name: The Enamel Ring Rule
rules.body: A plaque or framed photo is edged with a solid zero-offset ring (white on blue, band around the rating, sign ink around the finale and reached stops), then a soft drop. Never a hard offset.

rules.name: The Readable Checker Rule
rules.body: The checker is ground, never under text: copy on a checker always sits on a solid blue plaque, and photos on it carry a white mat.

dos: Do treat this part as the Planet Patas world only; start any other business page from its own world.
Do keep the road one unbroken line from the hero to the finale, with exactly one van on screen at a time.
Do light each stop plaque gold when the van reaches it and keep it lit.
Do commit blue and orange as whole fields and fills; orange pills for the banho-e-tosa booking, blue pills for section actions.
Do set everything in Nunito, 900 to 1000 for names, headings and buttons, 500 for body.
Do edge plaques and framed photos with a solid zero-offset ring and a soft navy drop.
Do put copy on a solid blue plaque whenever it sits over the checker.
Do keep every section and the stop plaques fully visible under reduced motion or when scripts fail.
donts: Don't mix this world with Firmo or Da Vinti: no neon, chamfers, card stock, two inks or pen marks here, and no road, livery or checker there.
Don't drift toward the pastel paw-print-wallpaper pet template or a row of four service cards; the paw lives on the van and the favicon only.
Don't let the road wrap, break or switch sides between sections.
Don't set gold as text on white or tint.
Don't use hard offset shadows or glows.
Don't set copy directly on the checker.
